How a project runs

Simple, predictable and no surprises.

  1. BriefYou send references, plans and a deadline. I reply with a clear quote.
  2. SketchA first rough pass so we agree on the direction early.
  3. BuildDrawings, models, renders or layouts, with a preview halfway.
  4. DeliverFinal files in the formats you need, with a round of revisions.

Hello!

I'm Ihsan, a fourth-year architecture student interested in spatial experience, contextual design and architectural storytelling. My work looks at how people relate to space through minimal, thoughtful, human-centred design.

I like architecture that feels functional and emotional at once, and I keep learning through observation, experimentation and perspective.
